articles.title: Sealed for 250 Years: Inside the Time Capsule That America Is Burying for Its 500th Birthday
articles.summary: A diamond, a Civil War eagle feather, and an AI prediction are just some of the items going into a time capsule that won't be opened until 2276. Buried at Independence Hall, it's designed to survive centuries and deliver a message from 2026.

articles.title: RNA Can Build Cages and Filaments, Upending What We Knew About the Origins of Life
articles.summary: New research reveals that RNA can assemble into complex structures like virus-sized cages and long filaments. This challenges the long-held belief that only proteins could form such shapes, and it reshapes the RNA world hypothesis.

articles.title: From 6% to 30%: Women Directors Rise in Latin American Horror and Fantasy, But Barriers Remain
articles.summary: At the Costa Rica Media Market, Sitges festival chief Monica Garcia revealed that female genre directors have surged from 6% to 30% in six years. Yet, panelists stressed that deep-rooted bias persists, and they're eagerly awaiting the next Issa López.
